steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}!! ${PlayerName}, are you all right? Hey, can you hear me? Come on... This is killing me!
The screaming in your head is turning your nerves into a mush. Such mental pain produces severe vertigo in you, and you start vomiting non-stop.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The shackles are putting too much strain on the Chief. What should we do?
Stay away. You're connected to him through the shackles. You'd be affected. Let me take care of this.
steps.female_content: Stay away. You're connected to her through the shackles. You'd be affected. Let me take care of this.

steps.content: He produces two Hyperpyramids and presses one against each of your temples. He lowers his head and looks deep into your eyes.
Wake up, ${PlayerName}. Listen to me. It's just you and me here. Focus your mind, then suppress it.
You're strong. You won't be defeated.

You're gasping, straining to hold on to his voice. Slowly, blue light chases away the scarlet mist before your eyes. You clam down and find yourself surrounded by your Sinners, who are looking at you with a worried expression on their faces.
The monsters from just now were the products of Zoya going manic—her mental contamination. Anger, resentment, hatred, and a reckless desire to wreak destruction.
She is extremely dangerous now.

options: ...She's still fighting. Just like us... She hasn't given in!

steps.content: She's connected to me through the shackles. Maybe there's some other way to prevent the Black Ring.
I understand. You see something that I can't. If what you see is hope...
Then go and fight, and I'll protect you.
You'll fight on. You hear her roar coming from the end of the shackles. Zoya is still there. You clutch the shackles that are causing you so much pain, ready to fight to bring her back.

options: Zoya, I'm coming. Can you hear me?

steps.content: From the other end comes a soul-shaking roar. Clenching the Hyperpyramids 036 gave you, you manage to pull yourself upright and head for the closed door, trying to catch up with 036.
...Don't touch me! Don't... order me around!

options: Zoya, hang in there, I'm coming!

steps.content: Get lost...!!

A heavy double door marks the entrance to the hall. It's got stuck in contamination. 036 is pushing it hard with one hand on each door. You come forward, put your hands on one door, and start pushing with him.
The chaotic roar stops short, and the other three voices around you disappear too. Silence descends. You've never felt so clearly the existence of the shackles connected to her.
...I hear it... It's you... It's you...
A voice pipes up in the depths of your consciousness—a dark, twisted, and decadent voice which evokes that familiar sickening feeling...
It's you! You're getting in my way!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!!
Spikes shoot out of the door, and a few of them pierce 036's torso. Hella makes to stop it, but is nailed to the spot. Hecate pushes you aside.

From behind the contamination-spouting door, berserk Polymers crawl out. You can hear the voice behind them more clearly now, a voice similar to the one made by the inheritance, but more frantic and wild.
...She...she is mine!!
